name: Luke
summary: A companion of Paul whom Paul called the beloved physician and one of his fellow workers. When others had gone, Luke was the only one still with Paul.

key_moments.title: The Beloved Physician
key_moments.description: Writing to the Colossians, Paul sent greetings from Luke, the beloved physician, and from Demas.

key_moments.title: Only Luke Stayed
key_moments.description: Paul asked Timothy to come to him soon, because Demas had left him and others had gone elsewhere. Only Luke was still with him.

key_moments.title: A Fellow Worker
key_moments.description: Paul named Lucas among his fellow workers who sent greetings to Philemon, along with Mark, Aristarchus and Demas.
